rationale: User is requesting dark mode implementation which requires coordination between UI Owner (theme system, component styling) and Identity Owner (user preference persistence). Both owners need to work together.

ui_owner.prompt: Implement the dark mode theme system and update components to support theme switching. Coordinate with identity_owner on preference storage.

identity_owner.prompt: Implement user preference storage for theme selection. The preference should persist across sessions and sync across devices for logged-in users.

analysis.intent: Implement dark mode feature with user preference persistence
